text:
sara: :rotating_light: heads up — SAST CI on `main` is failing; scanner can't decrypt test fixtures, blocking the release. failing job: https://ci.redwood.internal/5481233201

matt: quick glance at logs shows KMS PERMISSION_DENIED on `keystore.decrypt` from scanner-sa. looks like an IAM binding was removed.

olivia: oncall here — can someone pull the audit logs to see who changed the keystore permissions? :eyes:

kevin: started triage. audit log shows a change at 5481233000 by infra-bot: removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from `scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. probable rollout last night.

scan-bot: scan run 5481233201 -> ERROR: KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR: PERMISSION_DENIED (stack trace attached in job).

sara: we need a short-term unblock: either restore the role or issue an ephemeral decrypt grant for the scanner SA. preferred: ephemeral grant + postmortem. who can grant now?

matt: I can run a short-lived grant. long-lived binding requires infra approval. two options: full add-iam binding, or ephemeral via keystorectl. example (full):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/scan-key \\  --member="serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \\  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```
but better:
```
keystorectl grant --sa scanner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --key scan-key --duration 30m
```

keystore-bot: Creating ephemeral grant for scanner-sa (30m) — grant id g-7a2f created by matt. Audit entry: https://audit.redwood.internal/grants/g-7a2f

olivia: ephemeral grant applied. kicking CI rerun now.

scan-bot: rerun started 5481233330

scan-bot: rerun finished 5481233350 -> PASS (only low-priority findings remain). :tada:

kevin: proposed follow-ups: 1) open infra ticket to restore the binding with justification or approve a scoped long-lived role if policy allows, 2) add an alert to detect KMS permission drift for critical service accounts, 3) update the SDLC runbook with ephemeral grant steps and include the audit link. I'll own #3.

sara: good plan. I'll open a PR to add the alert to alerting-config and update the runbook. tagging @matt for the restore ticket.

matt: filing INFRA-8821 to re-evaluate binding restore and TTL; will include audit link and approvers.

sara: please add the following to postmortem evidence: audit log entry id, grant id g-7a2f, who approved the ephemeral grant, and the CI job link.

kevin: adding notes to runbook and adding a nightly test that exercises KMS decrypt for scanner-sa to catch this earlier.

olivia: are we happy to close this?

sara: :thumbsup: resolved for now. follow-up items scheduled during the next change window.

matt: also recommending a small policy change: require a change request ticket for RBAC changes to keystore keys used by automation (SAST/DAST) — will include in INFRA-8821.

kevin: ack. I'll sync with compliance on audit retention for these ephemeral grants so postmortem evidence is preserved.

sara: thanks all. closing the incident thread — will link the postmortem when done.
